audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[].side reads 'Skill' while content win[] reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Lux/Lux/Lux, matching the packet chart. Seven rows render two answers.
audit.why: Karma's Mantra is available from level 1 and is the biggest single chunk in the lane, which is her early edge; Lux takes over at 6 because Final Spark is her first real kill threat and she fights from 1175/1150/1100 against Karma's 950.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to content/packet as one atomic group; phases[4..6].why rewritten to argue the Lux verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why all described Karma's own spikes on rows the chart hands to Lux, and no spike carried a cooldown or a range.
audit.why: Final Spark is 60/50/40s at 3340 range; Light Binding is a flat 10s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Final Spark's 60s and 3340 range; first item = a rooted target eating E plus R; 2+ items = the 1175-vs-950 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illumination was never mentioned: Lux's spells charge you and her next auto detonates it, and Final Spark both triggers and refreshes that debuff. The page also credited Karma with 'mana sustain via P' — her passive reduces Mantra's cooldown and gives no mana at all.
audit.why: Riot's text for Lux's passive and R; Karma's passive text in ownerKit.
audit.corrected: Illumination written into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; the false mana claim replaced with what Karma's passive actually does.

audit.why: Light Binding's flat 10s is the number the whole page's 'green light' system depends on.
audit.corrected: Light Binding 10s, Lucent Singularity 10s at rank 1, Final Spark 60s at 3340 range.

notes: Corrected a false claim about Karma's own kit: spikes[0].text and whys[1] credited her with 'mana sustain via P'. Karma's passive only reduces Mantra's cooldown on damaging abilities — it gives no mana. All seven phases[].side read 'Skill' against a content win[] of Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Lux/Lux/Lux matching the packet; the six changed sides are one atomic group and win[] already holds the target values, so there is no paired content edit to write. Range note worth keeping in mind for any later rewrite of the early-game prose: Lux outranges Karma at every stage (Q 1175, W 1150, E 1100 vs Karma's 950), so Karma's early edge is Mantra's burst, not range — I did not write any line claiming Karma out-ranges her.
